'''Watch Commander Zalaphil''' is a [[rare mob]] [[human]] found in the receiving room of [[Tiragarde Keep]] in [[Durotar]]. He is friendly towards Alliance players. 

He is a higher ranking [[Kul Tiras (kingdom)|Kul Tiran]] soldier and was dispatched with [[Lieutenant Benedict]] to continue [[Daelin Proudmoore|Admiral Proudmoore's]] goal of taking Durotar and killing the orcs.

==Abilities==
*Defensive Stance
*Shield Bash

==Objective of==
* Drop [[Canvas Scraps]] for {{questlong|Horde|7|Carry Your Weight}}.
